# Walk-forward evaluation at 72 h and 168 h, 2024-01-01 to 2025-06-24 (generated by `scripts/run_walk_forward.py`)

Quarterly retraining with the frozen hyper-parameters of each horizon (see the script docstring). MAE in MW, mean of the 3 seeds' predictions. **Windows marked * (2024-Q1, 2024-Q2) lie in the validation period on which the hyper-parameters were tuned and are not independent. Windows from 2024-Q3 overlap the test period** and are an additional, exploratory view of it; nothing is selected from these results.

## Horizon 72 h

| window | train / eval samples | best naive | ridge | XGBoost S4 | LSTM L4 | XGBoost minus ridge | LSTM L4 minus XGBoost |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2024-Q1* | 19,803 / 2,184 | 5,225 | 4,541 | 4,223 | 5,055 | -318 | +832 |
| 2024-Q2* | 21,987 / 2,183 | 7,310 | 5,938 | 5,601 | 5,900 | -337 | +298 |
| 2024-Q3 | 24,170 / 2,207 | 7,456 | 6,559 | 6,683 | 6,294 | +124 | -389 |
| 2024-Q4 | 26,377 / 2,208 | 7,356 | 4,886 | 4,654 | 5,529 | -232 | +875 |
| 2025-Q1 | 28,585 / 2,157 | 6,194 | 5,031 | 4,599 | 4,959 | -432 | +360 |
| 2025-Q2 | 30,742 / 2,039 | 9,150 | 8,480 | 7,715 | 7,573 | -765 | -142 |
| mean of windows from 2024-Q3 | | 7,539 | 6,239 | 5,913 | 6,089 | -326 | +176 |

XGBoost was better than ridge in 5 of 6 windows; the LSTM L4 was better than XGBoost in 2 of 6 windows.
